### Peace Beyond Performance: Unshakable Joy for the Ups and Downs
Author: Stephen Witmer
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/peace-beyond-performance
Passage: Luke 10:20
Points:
- The returning seventy-two disciples rejoiced over spiritual power, but Jesus redirected them to a deeper source of joy.
- Deriving our deepest joy from ministry success puts believers on a precarious emotional seesaw of pride and insecurity.
- Lasting joy is grounded in the reality that God Himself has written our names on heaven's register.
- Because salvation is God's accomplished gift, Christians can stay humble in victory and joyful in perceived failure.

### This World is Not My Home
Author: Mary Southerland
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-january-24-2023.html
Passage: Luke 10:20
Points:
- Jesus calls His followers to find their deepest joy in having their names written in heaven.
- Through Christ, a believer's eternal citizenship is transferred to heaven, making this world a temporary dwelling.
- Walking in a personal relationship with Jesus provides true security and belonging wherever we are.
- Keeping our heavenly home in view provides enduring strength and hope through everyday trials and worries.
